interpretations.bar_timing: bars are labelled by their start time; a 1-minute bar starting at t closes at t+1, a 5-minute bar starting at s closes at s+5. A decision is made at a bar's close and filled at the next bar's open.
interpretations.deadline: the confirming bar must close by 10:15 IST: index 1-minute bars starting 09:15+k .. 10:14, stock 5-minute bars starting 09:15+k .. 10:10. No confirmed state by then = WAIT, and the day ends NO_TRADE.
interpretations.filtered_entry: the protocol (FILTERED) takes the first bar before the deadline at which the break AND every filter hold together (a break that fails the filters can still confirm on a later bar). BASELINE takes the first break bar, no filters. Long or short, whichever confirms first; one trade per index per day, one per stock per day.
interpretations.agreement: index: Nifty 50 and Nifty Bank have both moved at least 0.05% since their 09:15 open in the trade's direction at the decision bar's close. Stocks: the stock and Nifty 50 both moved at least 0.05% since 09:15 in the trade's direction, Nifty read at the close of the minute that ends the stock's bar.
interpretations.breadth: share of eligible top-50 names (same eligibility rule, rank <= 50) whose last closed 5-minute bar is above their own 09:15 open. For an index decision at a minute's close, only stock bars that had closed by then are used. Fewer than 20 eligible names = breadth undefined; such days are excluded from the index tests (both versions) and counted.
interpretations.rvol: cumulative volume 09:15 to the end of the decision bar over the median of the same window in the previous 20 regular sessions; at least 15 of those 20 sessions with valid data for the stock, else not eligible that day; special sessions are left out of the baseline and of the study.
interpretations.vwap: stocks: cumulative (high+low+close)/3 x volume over cumulative volume from 09:15 to the decision bar's close (NSE-scaled prices).
interpretations.retest_E2: after the confirming bar, within the next 30 minutes (index 30 bars, stocks 6 bars): a bar whose low (long) comes within 0.10% (index) / 0.20% (stocks) of the broken OR edge without going more than that band through it, followed by a bar that closes beyond the band on the break side and does not go through the band; entry at the open of the bar after. A bar that goes through the band first = failed retest, no trade (counted). The confirmation is still by 10:15; the E2 fill can come up to 30 minutes later. Short mirrored.
interpretations.stops_X1: E1/E3: the opposite OR edge. E2: the retest extreme (lowest low from the bar after the break to the closing-away bar, long). Checked from the entry bar on; a bar that opens beyond the stop fills at its open, else at the stop. Time exit at the open of the 15:15 bar.
interpretations.stops_X2: distance = min(invalidation distance, max(m x OR width, floor)); floor = max(2 ticks, 0.5 x ATR14 of 5-minute bars at entry). m = 80th percentile of MAE / OR width of the dev-period (2015-2017) winners (net > 0) of the same instrument, k and entry under X1, FILTERED version; BASELINE uses the same m (same exits). Walk-forward folds refit m on all years before the test year.
interpretations.atr5: ATR14 over the 14 most recent closed 5-minute bars, the previous session's tail included when today has fewer; true range within a session uses the previous bar's close, the first bar of a session uses its own range. Stocks use Kite's adjusted prices as a percentage (no corporate-action jumps), applied to the NSE-scaled price.
interpretations.index_proxy: Nifty 50 / Nifty Bank spot minutes stand in for the near-month future (basis ignored, labelled). Costs: Zerodha futures fees of that year on one lot of that date (lot size from the F&O bhavcopy, nearest expiry), plus 1 tick of slippage on entry and 1 on exit.
interpretations.stock_costs: intraday equity fees of that year; half-spread by turnover rank (costs.HALF_SPREAD_BPS, an estimate) on both legs; slippage of half the half-spread again on the entry and on a stop exit (costs.py convention). Per-unit bps are computed on a Rs 1 lakh order per leg (brokerage at the Rs 20 cap = 0.02%); the sizing layer recomputes on the real order value.
interpretations.eligibility: stocks: rank <= 100 in gold/universe on the previous session; kite symbol linked to the universe entity through silver/security_master/kite.parquet; at least 70 of 75 bars with NSE-scaled prices including 09:15; not ETF-like by symbol; no gold/ca_flags row (any status) within 5 sessions either side; a decision bar with high == low (circuit or no trade) cannot confirm. Missing bars inside a valid day are filled flat from the previous close.
interpretations.index_days: regular sessions with the 09:15 bar and at least 360 of 375 minutes for both Nifty 50 and Nifty Bank; special (weekend / Muhurat) sessions excluded.
interpretations.statistics: metric: net bps of entry price per trade (1 unit). Index NET: t across trade-days of the FILTERED trades. Index VS_BASE: across days on which BASELINE traded, FILTERED day result (0 if no trade) minus BASELINE day result; positive = the confirmation improves on the plain rule. BASE_NET: the plain rule's own trades. Stocks: per-day mean over the day's trades, then t across days; VS_BASE per day over the union of names traded by either version (0 for no trade). Dev 2015-2017, validation 2018-2023; ledger family OC; expected sign + for NET, VS_BASE, BASE_NET.
interpretations.event_day_test: scheduled event days = verified (OFFICIAL / TWO_SOURCES) registry events of category rbi_policy, union_budget or election whose first tradable session is the event date. Each falls after 09:45 (RBI and Budget announcements; counting trends run all session), so standing down until 30 minutes after the event means no OC entry under the 10:15 deadline on those days. Test: k30|E1|X1 FILTERED net bps on event days; hypothesis: negative (stand-down beats trading through), expected sign -.
interpretations.folds: expanding walk-forward, test years 2016..2023: per test year, the variant's mean net bps (X2 with m refit on earlier years). Robust if at least 5 of 8 folds are positive.
interpretations.shuffle_stocks: within each day, the FILTERED set is replaced by a random set of the same size from that day's BASELINE trades (their baseline results); 500 draws; p = share of draws whose mean is at or above the FILTERED mean. Tests selection, not timing.
interpretations.sizing: Rs max risk from paper_config.json (intraday.max_risk_per_trade_inr). Index: lots = floor(max_risk / ((stop distance + per-unit cost) x lot size)); 0 lots = NO_TRADE with reason risk_cap. Stocks: shares = floor(max_risk / (stop distance + per-share cost)); notional above 5x the Rs 50,000 book flagged (intraday margin).
interpretations.wait_counterfactual: the plain rule's own result on the trades the filters rejected (per trade, dev and validation): negative means waiting saved money, positive means it cost money.
interpretations.ledger_rows: 74 rows in family OC: for each of 3 instruments x 8 variants, NET (the protocol), VS_BASE (does confirmation improve on the plain rule) and BASE_NET (the plain rule itself), plus the 2 event-day tests. Every row raises the family bar (Bonferroni over all rows ever tried in OC).
interpretations.exploratory_not_in_this_run: secondary grid (k5, B 0.55/0.70, rvol 1.2/2.0, VWAP off, tight consolidation, X3-X5, reversal, E4 10:15-11:30) and the synthetic options mapping run next, labelled EXPLORATORY.

note: written before any OC v1 result existed; the run refuses to start if the spec or these notes change
